blind.description: A stylized cluster of three farm/garden tools (a rake, a spade shovel, and a hoe) bound together near the top with a coiled rope into a self-supporting tripod. The handles are thick, warm brown faceted wood, tied with tan cord, while the working ends are dark cast iron / metal. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and clean with stylized cartoonish geometry. No floating or disconnected parts.
blind.from_above: Three rounded-hexagonal wooden handle ends clustered tightly in the center, wrapped with rope, with the dark metal spade blade and hoe blade flaring out to opposite sides and a wooden rake bar beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 60% of the figure's height (approx. 3.5 feet tall) and about 1.5 feet wide at the base.
